title: Instant, complete 10-language coverage across all zones and game UIs

requirements.summary: Make language switching update all visible UI strings immediately across zones, games, and shared components with no leftover strings from other languages.
acceptanceCriteria: Switching language from the language selector updates the visible text on the current screen without requiring a refresh or navigation.
In Turkish (tr), Memory Card Game, Logic Puzzle Game, and Problem Solving Game contain zero English UI strings (headers, buttons, helper text, toasts, labels).

For each supported language, there are no obvious untranslated UI strings in Game Zone, Quiz Zone, Coloring Zone, and shared components like Header/Footer/CelebrationModal (spot-check by switching languages and visiting each zone).

file_operations.description: Audit and replace any hardcoded user-facing strings with translation keys via the existing translation system; ensure all header text reacts to LanguageContext changes (re-render on language change).
Replace any hardcoded user-facing strings (e.g., privacy policy link text) with translation keys so footer text updates immediately when language changes.
Ensure all modal titles, messages, and button labels are sourced from the translation system (no string literals), and that modal content re-renders correctly on language change.

Audit Game Zone cards/labels/descriptions and any in-zone UI copy to ensure it is fully translation-driven and updates instantly on language switch (no leftover English due to cached derived strings).
Audit Quiz Zone UI copy (headers, buttons, helper text, empty states, toasts) to ensure it uses the translation system and re-renders instantly when the active language changes.
Audit Coloring Zone UI copy (template selection labels, empty states, tool labels, error states) to ensure it is fully translation-driven and updates instantly when switching languages.
Audit Home page navigation/welcome/age-selection UI strings to ensure all user-facing text is sourced from the translation system and updates instantly on language switch.

requirements.summary: Remove hardcoded English game UI strings and ensure Memory Card Game, Logic Puzzle Game, and Problem Solving Game use translation keys and/or fully localized fallback content for all 10 languages.
acceptanceCriteria: Memory Card Game: all labels (including theme/category labels like farm animals/wild animals/space adventures/cultural landmarks/etc.), instructions, and toasts are translated for all 10 languages.
Logic Puzzle Game: difficulty labels, puzzle category labels, prompts, buttons, and any feedback text are translated for all 10 languages.
Problem Solving Game: scenario intro UI, selection/submit controls, correctness feedback, and category labels are translated for all 10 languages.
No component in these games uses English string literals for user-visible text except through translations (e.g., no raw 'Select answer', 'Correct!', etc.).

file_operations.description: Audit the Memory Card Game UI for any remaining user-visible string literals (including theme/category button labels, headings, and toasts) and route them through the translation system; ensure any theme/category labels use translation keys that exist for all 10 languages.

Eliminate hardcoded English/Turkish puzzle text (notably the word-puzzle pools) and move all user-facing puzzle labels/prompts/buttons/feedback to the translation system; ensure puzzle-type selection labels are fully localized for all 10 languages.

Expand/adjust logic-puzzle fallback generation so any fallback content that is user-visible (especially time/word-related prompts) is available for all 10 languages and selected by LanguageCode (no English-only fallbacks).

Ensure all Problem Solving Game UI strings come from the translation system (category labels, instructions, selection prompts, feedback/toasts), and that language switching regenerates/refreshes currently displayed content where appropriate to avoid showing previous-language strings.

Replace the Turkish/English-only fallback pool with fully localized fallback pools (or equivalent localized selection mechanism) for all 10 languages so scenarios/options/correct answers never display in English for non-English languages.

requirements.summary: Ensure complete translation-key coverage for all 10 languages and add a dev-time missing-key safeguard to prevent silent English fallback in Game Zone, Quiz Zone, Coloring Zone, and shared UI.
acceptanceCriteria: For every key accessed via useTranslation in the app, translations exist for all 10 languages (tr, en, es, fr, de, it, ru, pt, zh, ja).
When switching to any non-English language, Game Zone cards (names/descriptions), Daily Surprise card labels, and in-game category labels do not revert to English due to missing keys.
Add a dev-time safeguard (e.g., console warning in development builds) when a translation key is missing for the active language, so missing coverage is detectable during testing.

file_operations.description: Complete the translations dictionary so every key used by the app exists for all 10 languages (tr/en/es/fr/de/it/ru/pt/zh/ja); enhance useTranslation (or the translation accessor) to emit a development-only console warning when a key is missing for the active language (and when a fallback is used).
Ensure any Daily Surprise UI-facing labels referenced from zones/pages use translation keys that exist for all 10 languages (and avoid constructing user-visible labels via hardcoded English).
Verify that every background music option label key referenced here exists in translations for all 10 languages; add/align keys to prevent silent fallback to English in shared components.

Add a development-only console warning when backend LocalizedText resolution falls back away from the active language (to help detect missing localized backend content during testing) while keeping runtime behavior stable.

Add a small dev-only helper that can compare translation key sets across the 10 languages and report missing keys (used by translations.ts and/or optionally invoked by pages during development to prevent silent gaps).
